instruments.notes: Costless collar entered April 1999; reference price Panhandle Eastern (Texas, Oklahoma Mainline Index). Expired before year-end 1999.
instruments.evidence_quote: In April 1999, Production Corp. entered into a hedge agreement in the form of a costless collar with respect to the production of 50,000 MMBTU of natural gas per day during the period of May through October 1999.

instruments.notes: Costless collar entered July 1999; reference price Panhandle Eastern. Text states that if the open gas collar had been settled on December 31, 1999 a gain of $769,000 would have been recognized.
instruments.evidence_quote: Additionally, in July 1999 Production Corp. entered into a similar costless collar agreement with respect to the production of 50,000 MMBTU per day during the period of November 1999 through March 2000

instruments.notes: Hedge agreement entered January 2000; fixed price vs Panhandle Eastern index.
instruments.evidence_quote: In January 2000, we entered into a hedge agreement covering 50,000 MMBTU per day at a fixed price of $2.435 per MMBTU.  This hedge is in effect from April 2000 through October 2000.

instruments.notes: Hedge agreement entered February 2000; April 2000 fixed price; reference Panhandle Eastern.
instruments.evidence_quote: In February 2000, we entered into a hedge agreement covering 20,000 MMBTU per day at a fixed price of $2.535 per MMBTU for the month of April 2000

instruments.notes: Same February 2000 agreement; May 2000 fixed price; reference Panhandle Eastern.
instruments.evidence_quote: $2.535 per MMBTU for the month of April 2000 and $2.555 per MMBTU for the month of May 2000.

instruments.notes: 10,000 barrels of oil per month (monthly volume only; no daily or total stated). Entered August 1999. Text states that if the open crude oil hedge had been settled on December 31, 1999 a loss of $282,000 would have been recognized.
instruments.evidence_quote: In August 1999, Production Corp. entered into a hedge agreement covering 10,000 barrels of oil per month at a fixed price of $20.10 per barrel.  This hedge is in effect from September 1999 through August 2000.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: From time to time enters hedging agreements (collars, fixed-price swaps) on gas and oil production to reduce price volatility; does not acquire, hold or issue financial instruments for trading purposes.
